scope: PostgreSQL 17.6 loopback; independent transactions, synthetic request/confirmed-booking fixtures and controlled authorization/readiness helpers. Not full schema, staging, Stripe or realtime.

tests.name: two providers concurrently accept: exactly one committed assignment
repeat acceptance after lost response cannot create duplicate assignment
stale offer cannot create an assignment
offline provider cannot create an assignment
stale location cannot create an assignment
cancelled request cannot create an assignment
missing capability cannot create an assignment
outside provider radius cannot create an assignment
another account cannot accept a provider offer
completion progresses through allowed states and is authorized
customer cancellation expires offers and is not repeat-success
simultaneous customer quote decisions have no deadlock and exactly one booking
tests.error:
customer acceptance must not deadlock

true !== false
